native_seconds_basis: NASA Exoplanet Archive TOI pl_orbper converted from days to seconds; not estimated from SPOC flux
effective_sample_size_method: quality-zero finite PDCSAP flux; clipped AR(1) n * (1-rho1) / (1+rho1)
noise_floor_method: median(PDCSAP_FLUX_ERR) / (1.4826 * MAD(PDCSAP_FLUX)) on quality-zero finite rows
applicability: TESS-SPOC PDCSAP light curves for unique non-false-positive TOI hosts with one non-limit external orbital period and at least eight observed orbital cycles.
limitations: An orbital period defines phase but does not prove that stellar flux traces orbital shape. The AR(1) approximation does not model higher-order or non-stationary dependence. Error-over-MAD is a relative photometric noise proxy, not a complete instrument or astrophysical noise model. MAST extension CHECKSUM headers observed in this acquisition are stale; exact downloaded bytes are instead bound by SHA-256 and the checksum status remains recorded. The measured 64-record inventory produced no pool with 48 admitted alternatives under the frozen contract.
claim_boundary: Adoption approves these single-record marginal calculations for profile construction only. It does not approve any target, establish independence or exchangeability, guarantee a resolvable pool, or license a correspondence result.
